name: chat-recall
description: Turn what your AI coding tools already write into shared team knowledge, leaked-secret alerts, ranked code findings and tracked tasks. Every coding agent keeps a full transcript of its work and nothing reads it: chat-recall indexes Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Antigravity and Cursor sessions into one place, redacts secrets on the way, and serves the result to your agent over MCP. Free and self-hosted, or hosted.
